{"code": "from scipy.stats import chi2_contingency

# Check if the imbalance is statistically significant for each covariate

# Site
site_table = data.groupby(['arm', 'site']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
chi2, p_site, dof, expected = chi2_contingency(site_table)

# Sex
sex_table = data.groupby(['arm', 'sex']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
chi2, p_sex, dof, expected = chi2_contingency(sex_table)

# Severity
severity_table = data.groupby(['arm', 'severity']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
chi2, p_severity, dof, expected = chi2_contingency(severity_table)

print(f"Site p-value: {p_site}")
print(f"Sex p-value: {p_sex}")
print(f"Severity p-value: {p_severity}")"}
